sources.researchNote: The listing reads: “Bach-Saal, Sonnab., 3. Dezember, abends 8 Uhr Klavier-Abend F. Chopin (4 Balladen), Szymanowski, B. Kaper, Ravel, Albeniz, Liszt (H-moll).” It fixes the hall, the date and the programme, and names Kaper among the composers without naming his work. It does not describe any item as a first performance: the words zum ersten Male and Uraufführung do not appear, although the guide uses Neuaufführungen elsewhere in the same issue.

sources.publication: Führer durch die Konzertsäle Berlins: der Berliner Kulturspiegel
sources.researchNote: Two entries in the same issue carry the claim the earlier one does not. The premiere index reads “3. Dezember Bachsaal B. Kaper: Klavierkonzert”, and the Bach-Saal listing for that evening marks the composer “B. Kaper (Uraufführung)”. The guide distinguishes its terms in the same columns, using Erstaufführung and Neuaufführung for other concerts, so Uraufführung is used here in its strict sense. The index names the work a Klavierkonzert; the evening itself is billed as a Klavier-Abend.
